question: Within 160 kilometers, where can I find a fast food restaurant along the travel direction from Salus University, Elkins Park, PA to Manton Green, Philadelphia, PA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Salus University%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Elkins Park%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Manton Green%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Philadelphia%' LIMIT 1 ), travel_direction AS ( SELECT S.geometry AS start_geom, E.geometry AS end_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth(S.geometry, E.geometry)) AS main_azimuth FROM start_point S, end_point E ) SELECT P.poi_name, P.addr_state, P.addr_city FROM pois P, travel_direction TD WHERE P.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin(P.geometry::geography, TD.start_geom::geography, 160000) -- Within 160 kilometers (160,000 meters) of the start point AND ( -- Calculate the angular difference between the main travel direction and the direction to the POI -- and ensure it's within a 90-degree cone (45 degrees on either side of the main direction) LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(TD.start_geom, P.geometry)) - TD.main_azimuth), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(TD.start_geom, P.geometry)) - TD.main_azimuth) ) <= 45 );

answers.description: greasy hole full of questionable eats
